meaning.en: NEMA 5-15 receptacle (Type B, North American household AC with ground), shown as the socket face seen from the front, ground hole down
meaning.de: NEMA-5-15-Steckdose (Typ B, nordamerikanische Haushaltssteckdose mit Schutzkontakt), dargestellt als Steckdosenfläche von vorn, Schutzkontakt unten

standard.source: ANSI/NEMA WD 6 (5-15R) not consulted; contact layout taken from the OpenPlugDB front view "NEMA 5-15R receptacle (female), mating face, ground hole down" (https://github.com/ovarilo/openplugdb/blob/main/public/images/connectors/nema-5-15/5-15r-receptacle-front.svg, retrieved 2026-11-08), drawn from Wikipedia "NEMA connector" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NEMA_connector, retrieved 2026-11-08); WorldStandards "Plug type B" (https://www.worldstandards.eu/electricity/plugs-and-sockets/b/, retrieved 2026-11-08)
